choice: DRAGON-25 v1.0 selected for primary RPA released identity encoder; no alternative evaluated
learned: Frozen author PatchCNN.features 1024-d post-global-pool; all 64 nonoverlapping 64x64 RGB patches at 512x512; average patch features. Source normalization from checkpoint, float32 eval; no learned dimensionality reduction.
control: 40 dimensions: per-channel mean/std/mean absolute/fourth moment of RGB minus PIL GaussianBlur radius1 (12); luminance demeaned Hann-window 512 FFT power normalized by total, 24 equal radial bins 0..sqrt(.5), then 4 angular quadrants at radius>=.25; log10(mean bin power +1e-20) (28). Fixed investigative control, not published method replication.
pixels: Existing normalized RGB512 source pixels only; no metadata, dimensions, filenames or label text in encoders; safety excluded sample stays excluded.
splits: Original 12/6/6 whole prompt families, seeds unchanged; train/cal only SD14/SD15; no SDXL fit/selection
fit: train-only StandardScaler then RidgeClassifier; alphas [100,10,1,.1], maximize calibration accuracy, first/largest tie; no refit on cal; no PCA
rejection: Nearest train class-centroid Euclidean RMS distance in train-standardized feature space; threshold calibration known-only 95th quantile method=higher; reject strictly above; no SDXL calibration
smoke: first train+cal image each SD14/SD15, assert RGB512 pixel hashes/finite 1024 and40 dims/repeated learned features exactly identical before main pass; stop on failure pending logged amendment within readiness budget
robustness: Same heldout only JPEG85 PIL subsampling2; LANCZOS downsize256 upsize512; no tuning/refit
baselines: Recompute train/cal ridge heads and heldout original PickScore, visual12 and visual+PickScore13 on exact same usable primary samples. Reuse frozen original PickScore scalar; no judge re-inference. Visual features recomputed from pixels.
uncertainty: 2000 whole-family draws seed904; recompute sum correct / sum n; paired same draws; conditional only six families/shared seeds; count intervals plus sample precision acknowledged; no abstention in closed set accuracy
limits: One learned checkpoint; no generation/quality model/judge/hosted inference/Livepeer/credentials/product edits/commits/publication/daemons/child agents. <=2 GPUh <=3h wall readiness <=30min.
